entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. To place a new order, press two. To speak with a representative, please stay on the line.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sam, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working for me. My order number is VF-1138-99.
I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up your order... VF-1138-99. Okay, I see it here. Delivered about two weeks ago. Not a problem, you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, 90 days? That's fantastic. I was worried I had missed the cut-off. So you can just email me a return label?

Absolutely. Let me just generate that for you... ah. One moment. It seems... my apologies, I've made an error. I was looking at the policy for our apparel. For electronics like the VeloBand, the return policy is actually 14 days.
Excuse me? No, **you just said** 90 days. I heard you. I'm one day over your '14-day' policy, but you told me I was fine.

I understand your frustration, sir, and I sincerely apologize for misspeaking. I provided you with incorrect information. The system is showing the return window for this specific item closed yesterday.
This is ridiculous. You **promised me** I was 'well within the window.' This feels like a classic **bait and switch**. Is this a **recorded line**?
Yes sir, for quality assurance, all our calls are recorded. And you are correct, I did give you the wrong information. That was my mistake entirely.
Then you need to fix it. I'm not going to be stuck with this thing because of your error.
I agree completely. Please allow me to put you on a brief hold. I need to get a supervisor's approval to override the system, but I am confident we can get this sorted out for you.
Fine. Make it quick.

Thank you for your patience. I've just spoken with my manager, and given my error, we are absolutely going to honor the 90-day window I quoted you. I have manually processed the return authorization for you.
So I can send it back for a full refund?

Yes. A pre-paid return shipping label is on its way to your email right now. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days. Again, I am very sorry for the confusion.
Okay... well, thank you. I appreciate you taking care of that and not just leaving me stuck.
Of course. It was our mistake to correct. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
